title: CRA gap check input
description: Supply an SBOM and the facts about your product. Optionally add a Grype scan result.

productName.title: Product name
productName.description: The product the SBOM describes. Compared with the SBOM's top-level component.
productName.sectionDescription: Declared by you and not verified. They appear in the report as declared.

productVersion.title: Product version
productVersion.description: Version of the product the SBOM describes.

vendor.title: Manufacturer
vendor.description: Name of the manufacturer or vendor.

supportPeriodEnd.title: Support period end
supportPeriodEnd.description: Last day you commit to ship security updates, as YYYY-MM-DD.

securityContact.title: Security contact
securityContact.description: An email address or an https URL where people report vulnerabilities.

securityTxtUrl.title: security.txt URL
securityTxtUrl.description: Optional https URL of your RFC 9116 security.txt. It is fetched and checked for a Contact field and an Expires date.

securityPolicyUrl.title: Security policy URL
securityPolicyUrl.description: Optional https URL of your SECURITY.md (raw text). It is fetched and checked for a reporting contact.

sbomUrl.title: SBOM URL
sbomUrl.description: https URL of a CycloneDX JSON or SPDX 2.x JSON SBOM (max 15 MiB). Use this or the pasted SBOM below, not both.
sbomUrl.sectionDescription: Exactly one of the URL or the pasted JSON.

sbomJson.title: SBOM (pasted JSON)
sbomJson.description: A CycloneDX or SPDX 2.x SBOM pasted as JSON.

grypeUrl.title: Grype result URL
grypeUrl.description: Optional https URL of the JSON output of grype -o json (max 15 MiB). Without a scan, the vulnerability checks report that no scan ran.
grypeUrl.sectionDescription: At most one of the URL or the pasted JSON.

grypeJson.title: Grype result (pasted JSON)
grypeJson.description: The JSON output of grype -o json, pasted.
